title: Chip carving
summary: Cut the chips of a rosette from a lime-wood board: a ring of triangles and a six-pointed star.
howToPlay: The lit piece in its frame shows what to make.
Drag across the block to take wood away; two chisels, fine and broad. Zoom in to work close and use the Hand to move the view.
Rub the Wax cloth over the finished piece, then press Check.
rules: Removing a cell inside the shape costs as much as leaving one outside it.
Undo takes back one stroke. Waxing is for the finish and does not change the score.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn carves and waxes a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Chip carving removes small three-cornered chips with a knife, row by row, so that light and shade make a pattern. Geometric rosettes drawn with a compass decorate boxes, plates and furniture across the Alps.
